newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mori Denki postpones planned new share issue--TSE.
newsitem.headline: Mori Denki postpones planned new share issue--TSE.

text.p: Mori Denki Manufacturing Co Ltd has postponed its planned new share issue by one month until December 19, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said in a statement on Monday.

On October 24, the maker of industrial lighting equipment announced that it would issue eight million new shares in a third-party allocation to Shodai Nitta, president of shopping centre operator Shinshin Shoji KK, following a business and equity tie-up between the two firms.
But the TSE said Mori Denki had modified the terms of the new share issue, which was originally due to take place on Monday at an issue price of 415 yen per share.
The company now plans to issue 7.2 million new shares through a third-party allocation at a price of 456 yen per share. The new payment date is December 19, the TSE said.
Mori Denki's shares closed at 650 yen on Monday.
